name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Matteo Ricci
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection that Matteo Ricci, an Italian member of the Parliament, holds as an elected representative. Italian prosecutors in Pesaro asked for this because they want to use emails and online conversations between Ricci and one of his staff, found on his phone, in a criminal case about alleged corruption. The alleged acts date from when he was mayor of Pesaro, before he became a member of the European Parliament.

- Ricci loses his protection from this Italian investigation, so prosecutors can use the messages.
- It affects Ricci only; the case involves 26 other people but not their protection.
- Italy's prosecutors can now proceed; Parliament's President will tell them and Ricci.
